scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && eslint "dist/**/*.js" --fix && bun run schemas && bun run sync-dist
scripts.sync-dist: cp metadata.json dist/metadata.json && mkdir -p dist/schemas && cp schemas/*.gschema.xml schemas/gschemas.compiled dist/schemas/
scripts.pack: bun run stage && (cd build && gnome-extensions pack --force --extra-source=LICENSE --extra-source=types.js --extra-source=geometry.js --extra-source=clone-opacity.js --extra-source=keybindings.js --extra-source=quake-manager.js --extra-source=prefs .) && mv -f build/quake-anything-extended@jeryban.gr.shell-extension.zip .
scripts.install-ext: bun run stage && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/quake-anything-extended@jeryban.gr" && rsync -a --delete build/ "$HOME/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/quake-anything-extended@jeryban.gr/"
